scope:
Exact finite checks of lexicographic degree-spectrum interpolation.

The recursion is compared with rational matrix solves. Margin KKT checks are
separately labeled exploration: equality interpolation alone does not prove
that positive-margin constraints are active. ReLU evaluations use 90 digits,
not interval arithmetic. The paper contains the all-dimensional proof.

positive_power_cases.scope: Exact integer cube-walk recurrences and finite monomial Walsh identities; the manuscript gives the all-dimensional induction and infinite-series argument.

deep_relu_cases.scope: 90-digit evaluation of the explicitly normalized fixed ReLU NNGP/NTK recursions; not a finite deep-network simulation or interval enclosure.

nonprefix_counterexample.scope: Exact rational counterexample to arbitrary-subset margin activity; not a counterexample to the prefix conjecture.

two_block_margin_cases.scope: Exact rational verification of the half-cube-plus-one multiplier formula and bounds. The proof reduces dyadic and two-block prefixes to this case or a full/one-missing cube.
